text.zh:
氚、氚化物和氚的混合物，以及含有上述任何一种物质的产品（氚-氢原子比超过千分之一的），不包括含氚（任何形态）量小于
1.48×10³GBq 的产品。发射α粒子，其α半衰期为 10 天或更长但小于 200 年的放射性核素（ 1. 单质 ； 2. 含有 α 总活度为37GBq/kg 或更大的任何这类放射性核素的化合物；3.含有α总活度为 37GBq/kg 或更大的任何这类放射性核素的混合物；4.含有任何上述物质的产品，不包括所含α活度小于 3.7GBq 的产品）。其他放射性元素、同位素及其化合物 （ 子目 284410 、 284420 、284430 以外的放射性元素，同位素）。

Compounds containing any of these radionuclides with a total alpha activity of 37 GBq/kg or greater; 3. summary.zh: 为制造航空器结构件或航天器结构件而专门设计的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备

text.zh: 为制造航空器结构件或航天器结构件而专门设计的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备
text.en: Tools, dies, fixtures, and other process equipment specially designed for manufacturing aircraft or spacecraft structural parts

text.zh:
为制造以下任一物项而专门设计用于钛、铝及其合金 “ 超塑成形 ”/“ 扩散连接 ” 的工具 、 模具、夹具等工艺装备：
技术说明：
1．“超塑成形”是指利用超塑性金属材料在特定温度和应变速率条件下表现出的超高延伸率及不易断裂的超塑性，在模具型腔内将超塑性金属板料作为被成形坯料实现成形加工，以获得各种所需形状零件的成形工艺。
2．“扩散连接”是指相互接触的两个材料表面，在温度和压力的作用下相互靠近，局部发生塑性变形，原子间产生相互扩散，在界面接触处形成扩散层，从而实现可靠连接的成形工艺。
a．航空器结构件或航天器结构件；
text.en: Tools, dies, fixtures, and other process equipment specially designed for “superplastic forming” / “diffusion bonding” of titanium, aluminum, and their alloys to manufacture any of the following: Technical Notes: 1. “Superplastic forming” means a forming process that uses the exceptionally high elongation and resistance to fracture exhibited by superplastic metallic materials at specific temperatures and strain rates, forming superplastic metal sheet blanks within a die cavity to obtain parts of various desired shapes. 2. “Diffusion bonding” means a forming process in which two contacting material surfaces are brought closer together under temperature and pressure, undergo localized plastic deformation and atomic interdiffusion, and form a diffusion layer at the interface, thereby achieving a reliable bond. a. Aircraft or spacecraft structural parts;

text.zh: 电磁同位素分离器
text.en: Electromagnetic isotope separators

text.zh:
为一个或多个离子源设计或配备，能够提供总的离子束电流大于等于 50 mA 的电磁同位素分离器。
说明：
1．1B226 项管制能够富集稳定同位素以及铀同位素的分离器。能够分离一个质量单位差的铅同位素的分离器，必然能够富集有三个质量单位差的铀同位素。
2．1B226 项管制离子源和收集器都在磁场内的分离器，以及两者都布置在磁场外的分离器。
技术说明：单一 50 mA 离子源可以从天然丰度的给料中每年分离出不到 3g 的高浓铀（HEU）。
text.en: Electromagnetic isotope separators designed for, or equipped with, one or more ion sources capable of providing a total ion-beam current of 50 mA or greater. Notes: 1. 1B226 controls separators capable of enriching stable isotopes as well as uranium isotopes. A separator capable of separating lead isotopes differing by one mass unit is inherently capable of enriching uranium isotopes differing by three mass units. 2. 1B226 controls separators with both the ion source and collector within the magnetic field, and separators with both located outside the magnetic field. Technical Note: A single 50 mA ion source can separate less than 3 g of highly enriched uranium (HEU) per year from natural-abundance feed material.

text.zh: 氢-低温蒸馏塔
text.en: Hydrogen cryogenic distillation columns

text.zh:
具有以下所有特性的氢-低温蒸馏塔：
a．工作时的内部温度小于等于-238 ℃；
b．工作时的内部压力为0.5～5 MPa（5～50 个大气压）；
c．用以下任一材料制成：
1．用含硫量低并采用ASTM 标准（或等效国家标准）晶粒级别为5 级或5 级以上的国际汽车工程师协会奥氏体300 系列不锈钢制成；
2．耐低温并与氢（H₂）相容的等效材料；
d．内径大于等于30 cm，“有效长度”大于等于4 m。
技术说明：“有效长度”是指填料塔中填充材料的有效高度或板式塔中内接触板的有效高度。
text.en: Hydrogen cryogenic distillation columns having all of the following characteristics: a. Internal operating temperatures of -238 °C or lower; b. Internal operating pressures of 0.5–5 MPa (5–50 atmospheres); c. Made of either of the following materials: 1. Low-sulfur SAE 300-series austenitic stainless steel with an ASTM (or equivalent national standard) grain-size number of 5 or higher; 2. Equivalent materials compatible with hydrogen (H₂) and cryogenic temperatures; d. An inside diameter of 30 cm or greater and an “effective length” of 4 m or greater. Technical Note: “Effective length” means the active height of packing material in a packed column or the active height of internal contactor plates in a plate column.

text.zh: 水-硫化氢交换板式塔
text.en: Water–hydrogen sulfide exchange tray columns

text.zh:
水-硫化氢交换板式塔及其内接触器：
注意：关于为生产重水而专门设计或配备的交换塔，按照《中华人民共和国核出口管制清单》加以管制。
技术说明：塔的内接触器是各种扇形板，有效组装直径大于等于 1.8 m，其设计有利于逆流接触，并用碳含量小于等于

text.zh: 固态钨
text.en: Solid tungsten

text.zh:
以下材料：
c．具有以下所有特性，用于制造导弹部件的的固态钨：
1．具有以下任一特性的固态钨（不含颗粒、粉末状）：
a．非 1C226、1C241 项下管制的钨及钨含量大于等于 97%（按重量）的钨合金；
b．钨含量大于等于 80%（按重量）的钨掺铜；
c．钨含量大于等于 80%（按重量）的钨掺银（银含量大于等于 2%）；
2．能被机械加工成下述任一产品：
a．直径大于等于 120 mm、长度大于等于 50 mm 的圆柱体；
b．内径大于等于 65 mm、壁厚大于等于 25 mm 且长度大于等于 50 mm 的管材；
c．尺寸大于等于 120 mm×120 mm×50 mm 的块状物。
text.en: The following materials: c. Solid tungsten for manufacturing missile components, having all of the following characteristics: 1. Solid tungsten (excluding particles and powders) having any of the following characteristics: a. Tungsten and tungsten alloys containing 97% or more tungsten by weight, other than those controlled under 1C226 or 1C241; b. Copper-infiltrated tungsten containing 80% or more tungsten by weight; c. Silver-infiltrated tungsten containing 80% or more tungsten by weight (with a silver content of 2% or greater); 2. Capable of being machined into any of the following products: a. Cylinders with a diameter of 120 mm or greater and a length of 50 mm or greater; b. Tubes with an inside diameter of 65 mm or greater, a wall thickness of 25 mm or greater, and a length of 50 mm or greater; c. Blocks with dimensions of 120 mm×120 mm×50 mm or greater.

text.zh: 钛稳定双相不锈钢
text.en: Titanium-stabilized duplex stainless steel

text.zh:
具有以下所有特性的钛稳定双相不锈钢：
a．铬含量 17%～26.5%（按重量计）且镍含量 4.5%～7%（按重量计）；
b．铁素体-奥氏体微观结构（也称“双相”微观结构），其中奥氏体的体积百分比大于等于 10%；
c．具有以下任一形状：
1．每一维的尺寸大于等于 100 mm 的锭材或棒材；
2．宽度大于等于 600 mm 且厚度小于等于 3 mm 的薄板；
3．外径大于等于 600 mm 且壁厚小于等于 3 mm 的管材。
text.en: Titanium-stabilized duplex stainless steel having all of the following characteristics: a. A chromium content of 17%–26.5% by weight and a nickel content of 4.5%–7% by weight; b. A ferritic–austenitic microstructure (also called a “duplex” microstructure), with at least 10% austenite by volume; c. In any of the following forms: 1. Ingots or bars with each dimension 100 mm or greater; 2. Sheets with a width of 600 mm or greater and a thickness of 3 mm or less; 3. Tubes with an outside diameter of 600 mm or greater and a wall thickness of 3 mm or less.

text.zh: 硼材料
text.en: Boron materials

text.zh:
硼-10（¹⁰B）同位素富集到大于其天然同位素丰度的各种硼材料，包括元素硼、化合物、含硼混合物和上述材料的制品，以及上述材料和制品的废料或碎屑。
说明：1C225 项所管制的含硼混合物包括载硼的材料。
技术说明：硼-10 的天然同位素丰度重量百分数约为 18.5（原子百分数为 20）。
text.en: Boron materials enriched in the boron-10 (¹⁰B) isotope above its natural isotopic abundance, including elemental boron, compounds, mixtures containing boron, products of the foregoing materials, and waste or scrap of the foregoing materials and products. Note: Mixtures containing boron controlled by 1C225 include boron-loaded materials. Technical Note: The natural isotopic abundance of boron-10 is approximately 18.5% by weight (20% by atomic fraction).

text.zh: 镍粉
text.en: Nickel powder

text.zh:
镍粉和多孔镍金属：
注意：专门为制造气体扩散膜而制备的镍粉 ， 按照《 中华人民共和国核出口管制清单》加以管制。
说明：1C240 项不管制以下材料：
1．细丝状镍粉；
2．单块面积小于等于 1000 cm² 的单张多孔镍金属板。技术说明 ：1C240.b 项是指通过压制和烧结1C240.a 项所管制材料，形成整个结构内具有许多相连细孔的金属。
a．具有以下两种特性的镍粉：
1．镍纯度大于等于 99%（按重量计）；
2．平均颗粒尺寸按 ASTM B 330 标准或等效的国家标准测量小于 10 µm；
text.en: Nickel powder and porous nickel metal: N.B.: Nickel powder specially prepared for manufacturing gaseous-diffusion barriers is controlled under the Nuclear Export Control List of the People's Republic of China. Note: 1C240 does not control the following materials: 1. Filamentary nickel powder; 2. Single porous nickel metal sheets with an area of 1000 cm² or less per sheet. Technical Note: 1C240.b refers to metal formed by compacting and sintering materials controlled under 1C240.a, with numerous interconnected fine pores throughout its structure. a. Nickel powder having both of the following characteristics: 1. A nickel purity of 99% or greater by weight; 2. An average particle size smaller than 10 µm, measured according to ASTM B330 or an equivalent national standard;

text.zh: 基孔肯雅病毒
text.en: Chikungunya virus

text.zh:
人及人兽共患病“病原微生物”、毒素及其亚单位、动物 “ 病原微生物”：
说明：
1．1C351 项所管制的各类“病原微生物”，包括菌、毒种及各类活培养物，以及含有此类 “ 病原微生物”的各种生物材料（例如：细胞、组织、血清、带菌动物等）或非生物材料 ； 无论这些“病原微生物”是天然的，还是经过遗传修饰的都在出口管制之列，但以“疫苗”形式存在的除外。
2．1C351 项所管制的各种“毒素”，不包括免疫用毒素，以及经国家主管部门批准的人或动物用药物产品。
3．1C351 项亦管制属于我国境内新发现或生物学特征有明显改变，可对人、动物健康造成严重损害的人及人兽共患病“病原微生物”、动物“病原微生物”。
a．病毒：
1．基孔肯雅病毒Chikungunya virus；
text.en: Human and zoonotic “pathogenic microorganisms,” toxins and their subunits, and animal “pathogenic microorganisms”: Notes: 1. The “pathogenic microorganisms” controlled under 1C351 include bacterial and viral strains and all types of live cultures, as well as biological materials (e.g., cells, tissues, sera, infected animals) or nonbiological materials containing such “pathogenic microorganisms”; These “pathogenic microorganisms” are subject to export controls whether naturally occurring or genetically modified, except when in the form of “vaccines.” 2. The “toxins” controlled under 1C351 exclude toxins for immunization and pharmaceutical products for human or animal use approved by the competent national authorities. 3. 1C351 also controls human and zoonotic “pathogenic microorganisms” and animal “pathogenic microorganisms” newly discovered in China or exhibiting significant changes in biological characteristics that can cause serious harm to human or animal health. a. Viruses: 1. Chikungunya virus;

text.zh: 西方马脑炎病毒
text.en: Western equine encephalitis virus

text.zh:
人及人兽共患病“病原微生物”、毒素及其亚单位、动物 “ 病原微生物”：
说明：
1．1C351 项所管制的各类“病原微生物”，包括菌、毒种及各类活培养物，以及含有此类 “ 病原微生物”的各种生物材料（例如：细胞、组织、血清、带菌动物等）或非生物材料 ； 无论这些“病原微生物”是天然的，还是经过遗传修饰的都在出口管制之列，但以“疫苗”形式存在的除外。
2．1C351 项所管制的各种“毒素”，不包括免疫用毒素，以及经国家主管部门批准的人或动物用药物产品。
3．1C351 项亦管制属于我国境内新发现或生物学特征有明显改变，可对人、动物健康造成严重损害的人及人兽共患病“病原微生物”、动物“病原微生物”。
a．病毒：
17．西方马脑炎病毒Western equine encephalitis virus；
text.en: Human and zoonotic “pathogenic microorganisms,” toxins and their subunits, and animal “pathogenic microorganisms”: Notes: 1. The “pathogenic microorganisms” controlled under 1C351 include bacterial and viral strains and all types of live cultures, as well as biological materials (e.g., cells, tissues, sera, infected animals) or nonbiological materials containing such “pathogenic microorganisms”; These “pathogenic microorganisms” are subject to export controls whether naturally occurring or genetically modified, except when in the form of “vaccines.” 2. The “toxins” controlled under 1C351 exclude toxins for immunization and pharmaceutical products for human or animal use approved by the competent national authorities. 3. 1C351 also controls human and zoonotic “pathogenic microorganisms” and animal “pathogenic microorganisms” newly discovered in China or exhibiting significant changes in biological characteristics that can cause serious harm to human or animal health. a. Viruses: 17. Western equine encephalitis virus;
